verdict.rationale: The EC&VC practice page shows a genuine early-stage financing focus (seed/Series A fundraising, term sheets, cap-table tools, investor-ready scoring) and a decade-plus venture/growth financing history, but none of the evidence specifically names SAFEs, convertible notes/loans, or advance subscription agreements, nor any published explainer or form for such instruments.
